# AllToolkit

AllToolkit is a free online productivity toolkit at https://alltoolkit.org. It provides browser-based and server-assisted utilities for documents, PDFs, text, images, calculations, studying, productivity, security, and software development.

## Main sections
- Tool library: https://alltoolkit.org/tools
- PDF tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/pdf
- Text tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/text
- Developer tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/developer
- Calculators: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/calculators
- Image tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/images
- Student tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/student
- Productivity tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/productivity
- Security tools: https://alltoolkit.org/categories/security

## Popular tools
- PDF to Excel: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/pdf-to-excel
- PDF to Word: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/pdf-to-word
- Word to PDF: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/word-to-pdf
- Merge PDF: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/pdf-merge
- Password Generator: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/password-generator
- JSON Formatter: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/json-formatter
- Word Counter: https://alltoolkit.org/tools/word-counter

AllToolkit tools are free to access without creating an account. Many utilities process information locally in the browser.
